links.comparator_used: Non-adapted (original scheduled) plan on daily anatomy; selective replanning guided by a DL dose-prediction criterion, with daily replanning of every fraction discussed as the other alternative
links.outcome: PTV V38.05 Gy coverage and OAR doses when only fractions flagged by the DL-prediction criterion were replanned
links.effect: About 25% of fractions were flagged for replanning, giving a 1.2 pp increase in PTV V38.05 Gy and reduced OAR doses. Daily adaptation of all fractions raised the share of fractions meeting PTV V38.05 Gy >95% from 35% to 93%.
links.tradeoff: Daily adaptation may not benefit all patients on all fractions. Selective replanning of about 25% of fractions is proposed to optimize clinical resource use. The study did not report a direct head-to-head comparison of selective versus all-fraction replanning.
links.quote: Using an adaptation criterion based on DL prediction, approximately 25% of fractions were identified for replanning, resulting in a 1.2 pp increase in PTVV38.05 Gyand reduced organs at risk (OAR) doses.

design_hint: dose-prediction-based adaptation threshold for selective replanning
